battle.name: 白道之戰
battle.brief: 開皇三年（583年），西突厥莫爾可汗部南犯，隋文帝以衛王楊爽為行軍元帥率師北討，兩軍在代州白道谷口相遇。隋軍以重裝步兵結盾成陣抵住輕騎衝鋒，乘勝追擊數十里，斬獲以萬計，莫爾僅以身免。卡面的希臘重步兵不在隋軍序列，它標示重裝步兵以盾牆互相遮蔽的傳統，末代影子就落在白道山谷。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 白道之戰爆發於隋文帝開皇三年（583年）秋末，交戰的雙方是隋朝與第二突厥汗國西部的莫爾可汗部。隋朝方面是完成統一之後建立起來的中央集權帝國：全國兵制以府兵為骨架，宿衛與鎮守由京師禁軍和各地折衝府輪番充當，邊防則倚靠太原、並州、靈州等州的鎮軍與屯田部隊，出兵時由行軍元帥總督諸軍，各道行軍總管分道策應，後方由州縣徵發丁役轉輸糧秣與器械。白道在防線上的份量特別重：它東接太原、雁門，西通大同與陰山，是關中以北最直接的一條山道，隋廷因此把此次戰役視為整套邊防體系的試金石，而不是一次單純的邊境衝突。突厥方面則是草原聯盟式的汗國：可汗以牙帳為核心，靠盟誓與質子維繫各部落的從屬，兵員來自各部的騎士與步兵，戰利品、牲畜與牧地按部族分配。583年前後第二突厥汗國東西分裂，達頭可汗據西部，莫爾一系控制與隋境接壤的中段，實力有限；這次南進更多是為了奪取糧秣與牧場，同時趁隋朝主力壓在江南、北方防線空虛之際得手。
countriesEn: The Battle of the White Way broke out in the late autumn of 583, the third year of Emperor Wen's Kaihuang reign, between the Sui dynasty and the section of the Second Turkic Khaganate held in the west by the Mohe khan. On the Sui side stood a centralised imperial state newly consolidated after unification: the backbone of its military was the fubing militia system, with the capital garrison and the provincial units of the zhechong fu supplying the standing and rotating forces, while frontier defence rested on the garrison troops and tuntian farms of Taiyuan, Bingzhou, Lingzhou and other prefectures. When a campaign was launched, a 行軍元帥 (supreme field commander) was given overall command of the armies, campaign commanders (行軍總管) in each circuit handled the parallel lines, and the prefectures and counties behind them levied labour to move grain, ammunition and equipment. The weight of the White Way on this line was exceptional: on the east it joined Taiyuan and Yanmen, on the west it led to Datong and the Yinshan, and it was the most direct mountain road between the Central Plain and the steppe. The Sui court therefore treated this campaign as a test of the entire frontier system rather than a simple border incident. The Turkic side was a steppe confederation: the khan ruled from his tented headquarters, holding the tribes in obedience through oaths and hostages, drawing his soldiers from the mounted warriors and footmen of each tribe, and dividing booty, livestock and pasture among the tribal units. Around 583 the Second Turkic Khaganate was splitting east and west, the Tantuo khan holding the western part and Mohe's line the middle section that touched Sui territory, with limited strength; this southward move was above all a bid for grain and pasture, taken while the bulk of the Sui army was committed in the south and the northern line was thin.
people: 白道之戰留下的人名不多，但每個名字都帶著整套邊防體系的重量。隋文帝楊堅是此役真正的決策者：他批准沿邊全面進攻，命衛王楊爽掛帥，藉總督諸軍的授權把兵權、糧權與人事權集中在一處；朝中對先滅陳還是先平突厥久有爭議，他選擇用一次邊境攻勢換取北方安寧，把主力留給南面。衛王楊爽是出征主帥，楊堅次子，開皇年間已數次典兵，他率大軍出太原、沿白道峽道推進，會戰中主持正面進攻與追擊的決策。突厥方面，統兵的是莫爾可汗阿史那莫爾，《隋書·西域傳》與《資治通鑑》對他的名號、順位與所部範圍記載互有出入，只能確定此役由他率領汗國中段各部南下，戰敗後僅以身免，部眾星散。隋軍方面除主帥外，另有上柱國級的將領分道策應，但具體人名與分兵方式各書不一，此處不敢妄加指實。可以確定的是，這場戰役之後隋廷對北疆的政策由被動防禦轉為主動分化，數年之後冊封汗國內部的附隋派系、扶植內應，這一轉折正是從白道勝仗開始的。
peopleEn: The White Way campaign left few names behind, but each of the few carries the weight of the whole frontier system. Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, was the man who actually decided: he approved the general offensive along the border, appointed his second son Yang Shuang to command it, and used the grant of supreme command over all armies to concentrate command, supply and appointments in one place. The court had argued for years over whether to destroy Chen first or the Turks first; Yang Jian chose to buy peace in the north with a single offensive and to keep the bulk of his forces in the south. Yang Shuang, Prince of Wei, the field commander, had already held several commands during the Kaihuang years; he marched the main army north from Taiyuan, pushed it along the gorge of the White Way, and directed both the frontal assault and the pursuit at the meeting engagement. On the Turkic side the army was led by the Mohe khan, Ashina Mohe; the Sui Shu chapter on the western regions and the Zizhi Tongjian disagree about his title, his place in the hierarchy and the extent of the territory under him, and all that can be said with certainty is that he brought the middle tribes of the khanate south and that, after the defeat, he escaped with his life alone while his people scattered. On the Sui side, besides the commander there were generals of 柱國 senior rank coordinating on parallel lines, but their names and the way their forces were divided differ between the sources, and it would be unsafe to name them here. What is certain is that after this battle the Sui court's northern policy turned from passive defence to active division: within a few years it began to enfeoff the pro-Sui factions inside the khanate and to sponsor clients among the Turks, and that turn began with the victory at the White Way.
kits: 卡面這件希臘重步兵不屬於隋軍的編制，583年的北方戰場上沒有穿希臘式銅盔、舉圜盾、握短劍與標槍的方陣戰士，這一點必須先說清楚。它在這張卡上的位置，是重裝步兵這一兵種的源頭與技術譜系：頭盔、護脛、圜盾、標槍與短劍構成的組合，經馬其頓的混合方陣、希臘化世界各支傭兵大隊、羅馬軍團與晚期古代的鎧甲手，直到中古時期，仍以重裝步兵守陣、輕裝步兵與騎兵繞擊的基本分工留存在歐亞大陸的軍制記憶裡。落到隋朝，這份傳統已經完全換了血肉：隋軍重裝步兵戴兜鍪、穿明光鎧，肩與膝有護板，持方盾或楯，長兵器是長槊，佩橫刀與劍；輕裝步兵以步槊配弓弩，騎兵用角弓、長矛與馬刀。戰場上真正決定勝負的，仍然是那套老原則：盾牆接合成整體正面，長槊迎住衝鋒，把騎兵的速度綁死在硬面與地形上。此外，攻城與營具方面，隋軍備有巢車、擡車、雲梯，拒馬與鹿角用來封閉通道，帳幕、輜重車隊與橐駝把糧秣從太原、並州一線運到白道口，弓弩與大量箭矢是壓制騎兵逼近的主要手段。
kitsEn: The Hoplite on the card face was not part of the Sui order of battle: on the northern battlefields of 583 there were no phalanx warriors in Greek-style bronze helmets, with round shields, short swords and javelins, and that has to be said plainly first. What the card stands for is the origin and the technical pedigree of the heavy infantry arm: the combination of helmet, greaves, round shield, javelin and short sword passed through the Macedonian phalanx, through the mercenary columns of the Hellenistic world, through the Roman legions and the armoured infantry of late antiquity, and down into the medieval world, where it survived as a basic division of labour between heavy infantry holding the line and light infantry and cavalry working around the flanks. By the Sui period that tradition had changed its flesh entirely: Sui heavy infantry wore helmets and bright armour with plate protection at the shoulders and knees, carried rectangular or oval shields, took long spear-shafts as their primary arm and kept straight sabres and swords at the side; light infantry carried shorter spears with bows and crossbows, while the cavalry used composite bows, lances and sabres. What actually decided the field was still that old principle: shields locked together into a single continuous front, spears met the charge, and the speed of horsemen was pinned against a hard face and against the terrain. In addition, the Sui brought up siege and camp equipment: siege towers (巢車), lifting carts (擡車) and scaling ladders, with cheval-de-frise stakes and antler obstacles used to seal the road; tents, baggage wagons and camels carried grain from Taiyuan and Bingzhou to the mouth of the White Way, while bows, crossbows and large quantities of arrows remained the principal means of checking the approach of horsemen.
tactics: 白道是一條長約十八里的山峽，兩壁陡峭，東口通向太原、雁門，西口則是通往大同、陰山的內道。隋軍的戰法完全建立在這個地形上：大軍以步兵為主體，列成密集方陣沿峽道推進，前排是持長槊、結盾的重裝步兵，後方依次是弓弩手與輕裝步兵，輜重車與帳幕環列在將台四周，形成可以自守的營壘；騎兵分置兩翼與峽口之外，負責警戒、封鎖岔路與追擊潰兵。關鍵在一個封字：隋軍以一部封住谷口，切斷突厥退往漠北的通道，再以主力正面進攻。突厥的戰法是草原式的，輕騎不與隋軍正面糾纏，而是以數十至數百騎的小隊反覆逼近、放箭、挑釁，試圖把隋軍從隘口引出、分散其盾牆，再尋隙以大隊騎兵衝擊薄弱處；另一部分則沿山脊迂迴，企圖繞到隋軍側後斷其糧道。但白道只有一條出口，退路被封、糧秣不繼、援軍未至，騎兵的速度反而變成了被包圍的風險。會戰之後，隋軍以騎兵窮追數十里，直到對方分散歸牧，才收兵回防。
tacticsEn: The White Way was a mountain gorge some eighteen li long, with steep walls on either side; its eastern mouth led to Taiyuan and Yanmen, its western mouth to Datong and the Yinshan road into the steppe. The Sui plan was built entirely on that terrain: the army was infantry-led and advanced along the gorge in dense formations, the front rank being shield-closing, long-spear heavy infantry, with bow and crossbow men and light infantry ranged behind them, while baggage wagons and tents were ringed around the command post to form a defensible camp; cavalry were posted on the flanks and outside the mouth of the gorge, responsible for watching, for closing side paths and for running down fugitives. The key was to seal: a detachment held the mouth of the valley, cutting the Turks off from the road back into the desert, and the main body then attacked frontally. The Turkish method was the steppe method: light horse would not trade blows with the Sui infantry in the open, but small parties of a few dozen to a few hundred rode up repeatedly, loosed arrows and offered challenges, trying to draw the Sui out of the defile, to break up their shield wall, and then to find a gap for a massed charge, while other bands worked along the ridge in a flanking movement to cut the Sui supply line. But the White Way has a single outlet, and with the way back sealed, supplies short and no relief close at hand, the speed of the horsemen became a risk of encirclement rather than an advantage. After the engagement the Sui pursued for tens of li with cavalry, until the enemy had scattered back to its herds, and then returned to its lines.
data: 白道之戰的數字在史書裡分歧很大，能確定的只有量級而非精確值。《隋書·高祖紀》與《資治通鑑》都記載隋軍出兵以二十萬到三十萬計，通鑑另記楊爽所統大軍為二十萬五千人；這類古代動員數通常包含沿途徵發的丁役與輔助人員，真正披甲列陣的重裝步兵只是其中一部分，與希臘重步兵同樣屬於重甲兵種在隋軍序列中同樣只是核心而非全體。突厥方面，各書所記自數萬騎到百萬不等，多半是誇大之辭；較為可信的說法是莫爾可汗傾力而出的騎兵在數萬量級，並有相當數量的遊牧步兵與部眾隨行。戰果方面，較常見的記載是斬首萬餘級或數千級，追擊數十里、斬獲不可勝計，並記突厥棄甲仗、資糧而走，其帥僅以身免。距離與時間方面，白道東口至太原晉陽約二百餘里，白道峽長十八里；會戰在開皇三年秋末至冬初，隋軍自出兵至凱旋歷時約一兩個月。糧秣供應靠太原、並州一線的屯田與河東倉儲，維持這支部大軍在隘口駐紮數月。
dataEn: The figures for the Battle of the White Way differ widely in the historical sources, and only orders of magnitude can be treated as certain. Both the Sui Shu chronicle of Emperor Wen and the Zizhi Tongjian record the Sui army as numbering from two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand, the Tongjian adding that the grand army under Yang Shuang was two hundred and five thousand strong; such ancient mobilisation figures customarily include levied labour and auxiliaries picked up along the route, and the truly armoured heavy infantry in the line was only a part of that, in the same way that the Greek hoplite was the core of his phalanx rather than the whole of it. On the Turkic side the sources range from a few tens of thousands of horsemen to a million, and most of the higher figures are rhetorical; the more credible account is that the horse Mohe khan brought out numbered in the tens of thousands, with a substantial body of nomadic footmen and camp followers moving with them. On the results, the figures most often given are ten thousand or more enemy dead, or several thousand, a pursuit of tens of li, and kills beyond counting, together with the record that the Turks abandoned their armour, weapons and baggage and that their commander escaped with his life alone. On distance and time, the eastern mouth of the White Way lies a little over two hundred li from Taiyuan (Jinyang), the gorge itself is eighteen li long; the engagement came in the late autumn and early winter of the third year of Kaihuang, and the Sui army was in the field for roughly a month or two between departure and return. Supply was drawn from the tuntian farms and the granaries of the Hedong region around Taiyuan and Bingzhou, enough to keep this large army posted at the defile for months.
cause: 開皇三年的白道之戰，源頭是第二突厥汗國在莫爾可汗時期的內部失衡與北方邊防的空隙。583年前後，汗國的東西兩部分裂愈演愈烈，達頭可汗據西，莫爾一系控制與隋境相鄰的中段，部落的向心力被內鬥與牲畜爭奪削弱；加之連年的旱情與疫疾，草原上的畜群與部眾不敷所需，向南寇掠、尋求粟麥與牧場是最直接的手段。隋朝這邊，開皇元年以來雖多次遣使往來、頒賜衣物以安撫汗庭，但東、西突厥相繼內亂，羈縻政策始終無法穩住北境。真正引爆的，是突厥部眾在開皇三年夏秋直接入寇，掠取邊州存糧、驅趕軍馬、襲擊邊塞堡壘，隋軍將領據報請戰。文帝楊堅在朝議中把此次用兵視為先定北疆、後圖江南的戰略前提：只要把莫爾一系打回漠北，隋朝便能騰出兵力與糧道，在數年後的滅陳戰爭中不必再擔心兩面受敵。這一判斷，也解釋了為何隋軍在白道投入的是開皇年間規模罕見的重兵，而不是一次試探性的反擊。
causeEn: The Battle of the White Way in the third year of Kaihuang grew out of the internal imbalance of the Second Turkic Khaganate under the Mohe khan and out of the gaps in the northern defensive line. Around 583 the khanate was splitting more and more sharply into east and west, with the Tantuo khan in the west and Mohe's line holding the middle section adjacent to Sui territory; the cohesion of the tribes was being eaten away by internecine rivalry and by quarrels over livestock, and with successive years of drought and disease the herds and the people of the steppe could no longer support themselves, so raiding south for millet, wheat and pasture was the most direct remedy. On the Sui side, although the court had from the first year of Kaihuang repeatedly sent envoys with gifts to keep the khanate calm, the successive internal collapses of the eastern and western Turks meant that a policy of nominal submission had never settled the northern border. What actually set off the fighting was the direct incursion of Turkic parties in the summer and autumn of the third year of Kaihuang, taking the grain stored in the border prefectures, driving off the garrison's horses and striking the fortified posts of the frontier; the Sui commanders reported back and requested a campaign. In the court debates Yang Jian treated this war as the strategic precondition for pacifying the north before turning to the south: if Mohe's line could be driven back into the desert, the Sui would free troops and supply lines and would not have to fear enemies on two fronts during the war against Chen that lay a few years ahead. That reasoning also explains why the Sui committed an unusual concentration of force at the White Way instead of a probing counter-stroke.
impact: 白道一勝，隋朝的北疆問題並未就此消失，但問題的性質變了。突厥方面，莫爾可汗所部被驅回漠北，第二突厥汗國的東西分裂加速，實力大損，此後十餘年再無力組織與隋朝正面對抗的大軍，邊境由隨時可能被突破轉為可以被主動打回去，隋朝的邊軍得以從守禦轉為巡綏，士氣與編制都得到喘息之機。更長遠的影響落在隋朝的戰略選擇上：北方暫時安寧，讓開皇年間的國力可以集中投向南方，589年隋軍渡江滅陳，改朝換代，隋朝在完成統一之後只維持了不到二十年的統治。制度上，戰後的隋廷對突厥改採攻撫並用、以夷制夷的辦法，不再單靠正面會戰：先冊封沙摩略為歸義可汗，使汗國內部的附隋派系與反隋派系互相牽制，再在599至600年間派韓擒虎大破莫爾可汗主力於大斤山一線，西突厥問題至此才算解決。地理上，白道這條山道從此被北方強權反覆使用，627至630年唐軍正是由白道出師、夜襲陰山而滅東突厥；決定隋朝邊疆的這條隘道，四十多年後又成了唐滅突厥的通道，可見它作為內地通向草原的孔道，地位遠比一場會戰的勝負更長久。
impactEn: The victory at the White Way did not settle the Sui's northern problem, but it changed the nature of that problem. On the Turkic side, Mohe khan's tribes were driven back into the desert, the east-west split of the Second Turkic Khaganate accelerated and its strength was badly damaged; for more than a decade no large army capable of facing the Sui head-on could be raised again, the frontier changed from something that might be breached at any moment into something the Sui could strike back into, and the frontier troops could shift from pure defence to patrolling, with room to recover their morale and their order. The longer-term effect fell on the Sui's strategic choices: with the north temporarily quiet, the resources of the Kaihuang years could be concentrated on the south, and in 589 the Sui army crossed the river and destroyed Chen, changing the dynasty; the Sui held its completed unification for less than twenty years. Institutionally, after the battle the Sui court turned to a policy of alternating attack and inducement, using one Turkic group against another, no longer relying on pitched battles alone: it first enfeoffed Shamolo as Qiyi khan so that pro-Sui and anti-Sui factions inside the khanate would restrain each other, and then, between 599 and 600, sent Han Qinhu to shatter Mohe khan's main force in the region of Dajin Mountain, at which point the western Turks were finally settled. Geographically, the White Way road was used again and again by the northern powers, and it was from the White Way that the Tang armies set out in 627 to 630, striking the Yinshan at night and destroying the eastern Turks; the same defile that shaped the Sui frontier became forty-odd years later the road by which the Tang destroyed the Turks, showing that as a corridor from the interior to the steppe its importance far outlasted the outcome of any single battle.
result: 白道會戰的結果是隋軍的完勝，而且是那種會改變雙方長期處置方式的完勝。莫爾可汗的騎兵在谷口被隋軍的盾牆與長槊正面頂住，退路又被封死，隊伍在狹窄地形裡無法展開，潰散時只能拋下甲仗與隨軍糧秣，連同大批戰馬、帳幕與輜重留在原地；可汗本人僅以身免，餘部星散北返，數年之內無法重組。隋軍追擊數十里才收兵，隨後整軍回防太原，把白道這一段的邊防重新釘牢，也藉此役在北方諸部面前建立了難得的嚇阻。從帳冊上看，隋朝這次投入的是開皇年間罕見的大軍規模，雖然佔用了南征的準備時間，但北疆由此換來近二十年的安定；對突厥而言，這一仗的損失則更直接，失去的不只是兵員，更是可以據以向隋朝討價還價的實力。歷史給出的最終評價是：白道一役既沒有終結草原與中原的較量，也沒有讓任何一方稱霸北方，它只是把天平在一夜之間推向了隋朝，並在四十多年後被唐軍以同一條道路再次放大。
resultEn: The outcome at the White Way was a complete Sui victory, and one of the kind that changes how the two sides deal with each other for years to come. The Mohe khan's horsemen were met head-on at the mouth of the valley by the Sui shield wall and long spears, their way back was sealed, and in narrow ground their formations could not deploy; as they broke, they could only leave behind their arms and their baggage food, along with large numbers of horses, tents and camp gear. The khan himself escaped with his life alone, the rest scattered north, and for years they could not be reassembled. The Sui pursued for tens of li before stopping, then reformed and returned to guard Taiyuan, nailing the White Way section of the frontier down once more and establishing a deterrent before the northern tribes that was rare in that generation. Judged on paper, the Sui had committed one of the largest concentrations of men seen in the Kaihuang years; it cost time that might have gone to preparing the southern campaign, but the northern border bought nearly twenty years of quiet. For the Turks the loss was more direct, and what they lost was not only soldiers but the strength with which they could bargain against the Sui. The final historical assessment is that the White Way ended neither the contest between steppe and plain nor made any single power master of the north; it tipped the balance to the Sui in a single night, and forty-odd years later the Tang armies magnified the same result along the very same road.
